root.label: Tony Livesey leaves BBC Radio 5 Live

events.label: Tony Livesey leaves BBC Radio 5 Live

slots.name: departure status
slots.sentence: In an email sent to 5 Live staff on Monday morning, the station's controller Heidi Dawson said he had now decided to leave.

slots.name: station tenure
slots.sentence: Meanwhile, presenter Tony Livesey left BBC Radio 5 Live on Monday after 16 years at the station, the corporation announced .

slots.name: alleged meeting date
slots.sentence: One alleged victim said that Livesey had arranged a meeting between her and Sullivan in 1999.

slots.name: BBC start date
slots.sentence: The award-winning presenter worked for the BBC from 2006 - the same year he left the newspapers - appearing on 5 Live from 2010 onwards, including a successful stint hosting its drivetime show.
